sam: FYI payments flagged multiple chargebacks on acct_99887 after automated refunds. One cardholder filed for $4,200 saying 'unauthorized'. Need evidence and rec.
billing-bot: Chargeback created 1CB90011223 for txn `T20260520-4d1`  reason: unauthorized  dispute window closes 2026-07-19.
trisha: refunds were from our new auto-refund rule `returns-auc-1`. Rule fired after return_reason=rx-fraud-detect. System took merchant opt-in and auto-refunded within 2m.
kevin: API logs show POST /v1/refunds by client `returns-engine` (key: ret_key_live_xyz). ORIGIN_IP=34.210.120.5 UA=rfn-service/1.2. Webhook to merchant returned 200.
sam: ReturnsCo (partner) rotated keys on 2026-05-18 per their portal. Refunds occurred 2026-05-20. Need partner audit logs, operator IDs, and key rotation evidence.
kevin: Geo for IP Oregon, merchant normally accesses from EU. Rule didn't require merchant console approval which makes dispute defense harder.
trisha: recs: 1) place provisional hold on acct_99887, 2) pause `returns-auc-1` for this merchant, 3) request signed audit trail from ReturnsCo, 4) collect txn/refund requests + webhook receipts.
legal: Assemble merchant response packet with timestamps, API bodies, rule config snapshot, and partner rotation notice. We'll advise whether to contest.
sam: hold placed HLD-20260521-01 at 2026-05-21T08:45Z. Evidence packet uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evidence/CB90011223
